# coal.ui

55 original React 19 components. Install @chlohal/coal-ui from the local archive /downloads/chlohal-coal-ui-0.5.0.tgz and import @chlohal/coal-ui/styles.css. React and ReactDOM are the only peers; no external UI library or Tailwind is required. The package is not yet published to npm.

## Documentation
- /docs/foundations (motion, local optional Plex fonts, semantic intents and usage rules)
- /docs/installation
- /docs/theming
- /docs/coverage (reference library comparison and explicit advanced omissions)

## Local development
Use npm ci, npm run package:build, npm run dev -- --port 3100.
Local origin: http://localhost:3100. The Next.js site is documentation only. Package sources live in packages/react/src. npm run build creates the installable archive and site. This revision is local, not published automatically.
